verdict.rationale: Portkey is an AI gateway and observability platform, so a natural-language interface for operating it (configuring routing, budgets, querying logs) is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents only API, header and config-based operation. Its llms.txt file and remote-MCP connectivity are adjacent features, not a natural-language command interface for the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
